Lena (Support): customer reports invoice shows 1.2M billed tokens for March 9 but dashboard served tokens are 950k, customer complaining about discrepancy. attaching invoice id INV-2026-0339 and sample request ids.

Anika (Support): can you paste a sample request id or trace id? also what model + route were they using? 

Lena (Support): trace 8f7a2c4a; route /v1/generate; model: rwd-open-7b-q4h; they were using dedicated pool with continuous_batch enabled. customer says they saw high billed tokens right after a deploy.

Mike (SRE): looking at traces for 8f7a2c4a, I see a lot of prefetch entries from kv_cache prefetcher. snippet:
```
[2026-03-09T14:03:21Z] request=8f7a2c4a route=/v1/generate continuous_batch=on prefetch_keys=1
[2026-03-09T14:03:21Z] kvcache.prefetch -> matched_prefixes=3 served_tokens=0 billed_tokens=345
[2026-03-09T14:03:21Z] batch_aggregator -> created_batch_id=cb-7365 warmup=true
```

Mike (SRE): TL;DR: prefetch warmup in continuous batch is generating billed token counts (we meter on generation calls during prefetch) but these tokens aren't reflected as "served" in the application-level served_tokens counter because they are deduplicated at the prefix layer. That explains billed > served.

Anika (Support): ah ok. did this overlap with the model roll? customer said a deploy happened ~14:00 UTC.

Mike (SRE): yes deploy at 13:58 caused many cache misses -> cb warmups. continuous_batch warmup does speculative prefix generation to populate KV cache. Metering currently counts generated tokens at the runtime kernel level (per-token accounting), which increments invoice numbers. The served_tokens metric is at the gateway and ignores speculative prefetches.

Lena (Support): what's the recommended mitigation? customer asking for credit or explanation.

Mike (SRE): short-term: we can offer a one-time credit for the warmup window and add an annotation on invoice. I can also provide a per-trace breakdown that shows which billed tokens were from prefetch warmups. Long-term: we should either change billing to exclude speculative prefetch tokens or add a flag to opt-out of prefetch metering. I'll open an RFC.

Oliver (Billing): please open a support credit ticket with invoice id + exact token delta. i'll review. also cc @legal if we need to alter historical invoices.

Lena (Support): filed ticket SUP-12345, requested provisional credit of 230k tokens. customer replied they can accept credit if we fix root cause, they want a permanent fix.

Mike (SRE): repro steps I used:
1) enable continuous_batch.enabled=true on a small dedicated pool
2) clear kvcache on all workers
3) run 500 short prefix-heavy requests (curl examples below)
4) observe invoice counter increment > served counter in /internal/metrics

curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -d '{"model":"rwd-open-7b-q4h","prompt":"prefixX","max_tokens":64}'
```

Mike (SRE): metric paths: /metrics/runtime/billed_tokens, /metrics/gateway/served_tokens, dashboard: https://internal.redwood/metrics/dashboards/prefetch-metering?trace=8f7a2c4a

Anika (Support): can we give the customer a short note explaining prefetch speculative token billing and attach the trace? i'll draft.

Lena (Support): draft sent. customer replied :thumbsup: but also asked if they can disable prefetch on their Dedicated pool.

Mike (SRE): yes there's a config toggle kvcache.prefetch=false per pool, but warning: latency may increase for cold prefixes. advise how to toggle in the console or via API: 
```
PATCH /v1/pools/{pool_id}
{ "kvcache": { "prefetch": false } }
```

Oliver (Billing): noted. i'll provision the provisional credit after SUP-12345 triage. tracking: BILL-6003.

runtime-bot: automated note: release-2026-03-09 rolled continuous-batcher v1.8.2 to dedicated clusters at 2026-03-09T13:58:02Z.

Mike (SRE): action items: 1) create RFC to change metering behavior (SRE/Runtime) 2) add dashboard annotation for release rollouts (Observability) 3) support to offer credits and documentation (Billing/Support). I'll owner RFC: RFC-2056.

Anika (Support): thanks everyone. I'll update customer when credit is approved and include repro commands so they can toggle prefetch if needed.

Lena (Support): closing the thread on customer side, leaving internal followups assigned. :white_check_mark:
